name: wezterm
title: Wezterm
description: Open WezMacs workspaces and connect to SSH hosts in WezTerm.
author: ryan

commands.name: open-workspace
commands.title: Open Workspace
commands.description: Open a workspace directory in a new independent WezTerm window

commands.name: ssh-to-host
commands.title: SSH to Host
commands.description: Choose an SSH alias or discovered host in WezTerm

preferences.name: repoPath
preferences.title: WezMacs Repository
preferences.description: Framework checkout containing scripts/raycast.lua. Absolute path or ~/ path.

preferences.name: weztermPath
preferences.title: WezTerm Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute CLI path. Open Workspace requires WezTerm.app/Contents/MacOS/wezterm or a symlink to it. Otherwise searches the app bundle and standard Homebrew paths.
